name: DatePicker field
summary: Type or pick one date from a month calendar in the same field as Input, without antd.
highlights: One date in the Input field, typed or picked
A month calendar with min, max and today
ISO YYYY-MM-DD value, empty is null, joins forms
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-datepicker>, defined once and imported unchanged by React and Vue: the framework-free counterpart of antd DatePicker for a single date, so an app can drop antd for its date fields. It is the <aha-input> field (same tokens, small 24 · default 40 · large 48, error status, disabled, label, error and info message) holding one date, with a calendar glyph that turns into a clear button on hover and focus once a date is set. A click on the field or ArrowDown opens a month calendar below it (above when there is no room), in the browser top layer so a card or modal never clips it. The value is an ISO YYYY-MM-DD string, or null when empty; `valueAsDate` reads it as a UTC Date. The date can be typed (YYYY-MM-DD) or picked; typed text that is not a real date inside min and max goes back to the last value when the field is left. Focus stays in the field, a role="combobox" over a role="grid" calendar, so the whole control is one tab stop. The element is form-associated and <aha-form-item> reads, validates and resets it.
codeNote: antd DatePicker → <aha-datepicker>: value (Dayjs) / onChange(date) → `value` (ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' string, or null) + the `change` event, e.detail.value is the ISO string or null (`input` fires with it too) — so dayjs(v) / v.format('YYYY-MM-DD') wrappers go away · placeholder → placeholder (default "YYYY-MM-DD") · status error/warning → status (warning renders as error) · disabled → disabled · size small/middle/large → size small/default/large · allowClear → allow-clear (on by default; allow-clear="false" hides it) · minDate / maxDate → min / max (ISO); days outside are disabled · open / onOpenChange → the `open` property · locale → locale (month and weekday names through Intl) and week-start · aria-label / aria-labelledby → the same attributes, passed to the inner combobox · data-testid → on the host. Held, not supported: format other than YYYY-MM-DD, picker week/month/quarter/year, RangePicker, showTime, presets, disabledDate as a function, the month and year panels (PageUp / PageDown and Shift move a month or a year), inputReadOnly, renderExtraFooter. React 18: set `value` through a ref (el.value = v, null for empty) and listen with ref.current.addEventListener('change', …), since React 18 does not wire CustomEvents; pass a boolean as present or absent ({...(disabled ? { disabled: '' } : {})}); disabled="false" reads as off. React 19 can use the element directly. Vue binds it natively (:value.prop, @change).

spec.label: Box
spec.value: the <aha-input> field: height 40 (default) · radius 8 · padding 0 8 0 12 · 1px #E3E3E3 (border-default) · 240 wide, full width in <aha-form-item>

spec.label: Sizes
spec.value: small 24 · default 40 · large 48 (16/24 text), radius 8; sm / lg accepted as aliases

spec.label: Hover / focus / open
spec.value: #E70E68 border on hover; focus and open #E70E68 border + 2px #E70E68@30% ring (focus-ring-soft), on the persistent wrapper

spec.label: Status
spec.value: error #1A1A1A border, 2px #1A1A1A ring on focus, aria-invalid; warning renders as error

spec.label: Disabled

spec.label: Text
spec.value: Plus Jakarta 14/21, tabular figures · placeholder #616161 (text-tertiary), as <aha-input>

spec.label: End glyph
spec.value: system-calendar-dot 16px #8A8A8A (icon-muted); with a date set it turns into system-x-circle 16px #616161, #1A1A1A on hover (the clear button), on hover and focus

spec.label: Calendar panel
spec.value: #FFFFFF (bg-elevated), 1px #F1F1F1 (border-secondary), radius 8, shadow 0 6 20 #0000001A, 4px from the field, padding 8 12 4; fades and rises in (motion-mid, ease-out)

spec.label: Panel head
spec.value: month and year 14/21 semibold, 28×28 ‹ › buttons (system-caret-left / right 16px, #616161, hover #1A1A1A on #F7F7F7, radius 4)

spec.label: Days
spec.value: weekday 12/18 #4A4A4A · day 32×28 14/21, radius 4, cell 36×32 · hover #F7F7F7 (bg-hover) · today 1px #E70E68 inset · selected #FFFFFF on #E70E68 (the primary button pair) · keyboard day 2px #E70E68@30% inset ring · disabled #B5B5B5 on #F1F1F1

spec.label: Footer
spec.value: 1px #F1F1F1 rule, centred Today link button 14/21 #DB005B (text-link), underlined on hover

spec.label: Messages
spec.value: error-message: 12px system-warning-circle + 12/18 #1A1A1A text below, 4px gap · info-message: 12/18 #4A4A4A; both through <aha-field-error>

props.name: value
props.desc: The date as ISO YYYY-MM-DD. The getter returns null when empty or not a real date; set null or '' to empty it

props.name: valueAsDate
props.desc: The value as a Date at UTC midnight

props.name: min / max
props.desc: The first and last date that can be picked or typed; days outside are disabled and the ‹ › buttons stop at their months

props.name: placeholder
props.desc: Hint shown when empty; the default names the format the field reads

props.name: allow-clear
props.desc: With a date set, the calendar glyph turns into a clear button on hover and focus; allow-clear="false" hides it

props.name: open
props.desc: Whether the calendar shows; set it to open or close the calendar from code

props.name: locale
props.default: the nearest lang, else the browser
props.desc: Language of the month and weekday names

props.name: week-start
props.desc: First weekday column: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday … 6 Saturday

props.name: status
props.desc: Error border and ring plus aria-invalid; warning renders as error

props.name: error-message
props.desc: Shown below the field while status is error, linked through aria-describedby

props.name: info-message
props.desc: Help text below the field while there is no error

props.name: label
props.desc: Visible label above the field, a real <label for> on the inner field

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Not interactive, grey fill, no calendar; disabled="false" reads as off

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.desc: Name the inner combobox; aria-labelledby ids are resolved to their text across the shadow root and re-read on focus. A <label for> on the host works too

props.name: aria-describedby
props.desc: Ids describing the field, resolved on the inner field

props.name: previous-month-label / next-month-label / today-label / clear-label
props.default: Previous month / Next month / Today / Clear date
props.desc: The built-in strings, for a translated UI

props.name: name
props.desc: Form field name: the element is form-associated, submits the value ('' when empty), resets to its first value and follows a disabled fieldset

props.name: input / change
props.desc: Composed; both fire on each pick, clear or commit of typed text (blur, Enter) that leaves a new value

a11y.role: the inner <input> is role="combobox" with aria-haspopup="grid", aria-expanded and aria-controls; the calendar is a role="grid" named by its month heading, each day a gridcell with its full date as its name, aria-selected on the value, aria-current="date" on today and aria-disabled outside min and max; the field points at the keyboard day with aria-activedescendant
a11y.keyboard: ArrowDown opens; open: Alt+ArrowUp closes, arrows move a day or a week, Home / End the start or end of the week, PageUp / PageDown a month, Shift+PageUp / PageDown a year, Enter picks (or commits a typed date), Escape closes and restores the text, Tab closes. Closed: Enter commits the typed date. The panel buttons are tabindex=-1, so the control is one tab stop
a11y.note: Escape while the calendar is open does not reach a surrounding modal. The month heading is a polite live region, so paging months is announced.

whenToUse.when: one date in a product screen, filter or form: a predicate value, a date attribute, a start date
a date range, a date with a time, a week, month or year picker, or presets: the antd composite themed by datepickerTheme
a date answer on the audience phone: day, month and year fields on the deck

opinion.note: Set min and max to the real limits so the calendar constrains instead of validating after the fact. Label it with a noun phrase (Start date); a placeholder is not a label. Keep the value as the ISO string end to end.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the <aha-input> field chrome with the DatePicker look from datepickerTheme (brand selected cell, #F7F7F7 hover cell, radius 8 panel); sizes 24 / 40 / 48 and the error status as Input.
